old_description: Solar Zack & Team Sunshine operate all Towns in Vermont, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Maine and Florida. We install on all utilities and specialize in Solar for Homes and Businesses. We have a Solar Lease, PPA, purchase or financing option for everyone and we can Always save you money on your electric bills. Guaranteed. Some project even qualify for FREE installation.
about:
Solar Zack LLC is based in Moretown, Vermont, and operates across eight states in the Northeast and Florida. The company was established by Zack Mostov, a fourth-generation Vermonter who has spent more than a decade in the solar industry. Mostov also serves as a partner contractor for Team Sunshine Construction.

The firm provides residential and commercial solar installation, offering purchase, finance, lease, and power purchase agreement options. It also handles roof replacement and repair, managing permitting, financing paperwork, and utility interconnection. To date, the team has completed installations on more than 1,000 homes and businesses throughout New England.

Customers include single-family homeowners, commercial property managers, and multi-site operators in Vermont, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Maine, and Florida. The company works with all local utilities and focuses on both solar energy and roofing services.

Solar Zack emphasizes a low-pressure, friendly approach and notes that roughly 75 percent of its business comes from customer referrals. Its crews are experienced with New England roof conditions and winter weather, and the company handles all permitting and administrative tasks.

name: SolarPod
old_description: SolarPod has been in business installing solar on roof and ground since 2009. Our solar racking solution is award winning and places no roof holes making the roof water leak free forever. Z Rack and Z Lite have been installed in over 300 jurisdictions and growing.  They are patented, wind tested and revolutionary.
about:
SolarPod is based in Shakopee, Minnesota. Founded in 2009 by Mouli Vaidyanathan, who holds a PhD in Metallurgical Engineering and is a licensed Professional Engineer and Master Electrician, the company began as Mouli Engineering, selling modular ground-mounted DIY solar systems and installing conventional solar arrays. Vaidyanathan recognized that traditional racking methods damaged roofs with numerous penetrations, prompting him to develop a non-penetrating racking solution.

The company manufactures two patented racking systems—Z-Rack for sloped roofs and Z-Lite for flat roofs—in its Shakopee facility. Both systems are designed to eliminate roof holes, using a weighted, non-penetrating design that has been wind-tested and approved in over 300 jurisdictions. SolarPod also provides full installation services for residential, commercial, and utility-scale projects, and offers modular DIY kits that can be configured for grid-tied, off-grid, or hybrid operation. To date, the company reports 16 MW of installed capacity across more than 1,000 installations.

SolarPod serves homeowners, businesses, and solar developers across Minnesota and beyond. Its racking products are sold to installers, contractors, and developers for projects ranging from small residential arrays to a 408 kW commercial installation at Edina’s Cornelia Elementary School. The company also markets directly to DIY customers through its online store, where systems are priced by panel count and configuration.

Vaidyanathan founded SolarPod to address the structural damage and water-leak risks inherent in conventional racking. A partnership with OneTreePlanted adds a tree-planting component to every product sold.

name: Solartime USA
old_description: Ask How You Can Save $9000 With The Oncor Energy Solar Incentive
about:
Solartime USA was founded in 2009 in Richardson, Texas, a suburb north of Dallas. The business is run by Pawel Mierzwa, who oversees production, alongside his father, a business partner, giving the firm a family-run character. From its start, the company has focused on the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, offering custom solar and battery solutions to homeowners and businesses.

The company provides turnkey solar photovoltaic installation, Level 2 EV charger installation, battery backup systems, routine maintenance (inspections, cleaning, troubleshooting), and detach-and-reset services for roof replacements. It also handles all permitting and utility interconnection paperwork. With more than 3,200 completed projects and 17 years in the market, Solartime operates across the DFW area, typically installing systems in one to three days once permits are cleared—a process that can take two weeks to four months.

Customers range from single-family homeowners seeking energy independence to commercial property owners and multifamily housing managers. The firm’s EV charger service explicitly covers multifamily properties, and its solar installations serve both residential and small-to-mid-scale commercial clients throughout North Texas.

Solartime distinguishes itself with a production guarantee that refunds the difference if a system underperforms its projected output, a 25-year panel warranty, and 24/7 monitoring via a dedicated mobile app. The company emphasizes budget-friendly pricing combined with available incentives, and its focus on customer satisfaction from consultation through long-term service.

name: Solupac
old_description: We´re a leading manufacturer of generic and custom print high-quality plastic and paper products.
about:
Solupac is based in North Miami, Florida, and was founded in 2004 as a third-generation family-owned business under the parent company Tradepro Inc. The company was established to address a market gap in packaging, and today operates with offices in North Miami and Colombia, along with company-owned production facilities in South America. Leadership includes CEO and Managing Member Carlos Zaher and Managing Member Steven Schmutter.

The company manufactures both generic and custom-printed plastic and paper packaging products. Its in-house capabilities span design, manufacturing, and supply chain management, supported by a warehouse in Miami and production plants in South America. The product line includes mailer bags, reusable bags, trash bags, kraft paper bags, paper cone cups, bath tissue, industrial packaging, shopping bags, ice bags, die-cut bags, draw tape bags, security bags, C-fold paper towels, silverware bags, kraft paper rolls, napkins, fertilizer bags, medical waste bags, stretch film, and polyethylene gloves.

Solupac serves customers across North America, Central America, and the Caribbean. While the company does not publicly list specific industry verticals, its product range indicates service to medical, agricultural, retail, and industrial sectors.

The company emphasizes sustainability through a circular economy approach, sourcing recycled raw materials via Tradepro Inc. and developing compostable polymers and 100% recycled kraft paper. Its differentiators include rapid turnarounds enabled by in-house design and customer care teams in North Miami and Colombia, and a legacy of over 20 years in the packaging industry.

name: Solutions Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Solutions Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in November 1997 and is a privately held corporation located on Florida’s
about:
Solutions Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in November 1997 as a privately held corporation on Florida's Space Coast in Rockledge, Florida. The owners, who remain active in daily operations, bring over sixty years of combined experience in manufacturing, quality, and test.

The company provides electronic manufacturing services from a 33,000-square-foot facility staffed by approximately 65 employees. Its core operations include three surface mount assembly lines supporting prototype turns in 24–48 hours through mid- to high-volume production, alongside thru-hole assembly with robotic selective soldering and wave soldering, box-build and electro-mechanical integration, automated conformal coating and encapsulation, and complete product testing and burn-in. Additional capabilities cover boundary-scan testing, in-circuit programming, and a full quality system with IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001 certified inspectors.

Solutions Manufacturing serves customers requiring contract electronic manufacturing services, offering both turnkey and consigned program management supported by Kanban, just-in-time, and dock-to-stock material strategies, global sourcing, and end-of-life component management.

The firm states its primary goal is to form strategic partnerships with customers and deliver quality products on time, growing capacity in step with partner needs.

old_description: Solvers Manufacturing has opened a second facility 3 miles south of Springfield, NE on the East side of Highway 50. This is now our primary location for our key service offerings including plasma cutting, braking, welding, and more. Our neighbor is Wilson Premier Powder Coating, a commercial scale media blasting and finishing service provider.
about:
Solvers Manufacturing operates from a primary facility three miles south of Springfield, Nebraska, on the east side of Highway 50. The company also maintains a presence in Omaha, where it describes itself as an Original Design Manufacturer. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in public materials.

The shop provides a range of metal transformation services including CNC plasma cutting, CNC press braking (up to 10 feet), MIG/TIG/stick welding, ironworking, cold cutting, punching and shearing with a 71-ton dual-cylinder ironworker, and final assembly using precision ground fixture tables. It also offers professional services such as CAD modeling, product design, process analysis, procurement, supply chain management, and life-cycle planning. The company runs low-volume production and can output multiple thousand-count part batches. Its own product line includes cantilever dugouts, single drone trailers, service truck accessories, storage racks, and various steel fabrications for agriculture, safety, furniture, cooking equipment, and automotive sectors.

Solvers serves regional businesses, tradespeople, and product companies across industries such as agriculture, safety, furniture, cooking equipment, automotive, and general light-industrial manufacturing. It works with a network of local affiliates for machining, finishing, engineering, excavation, and roofing to cover capabilities not kept in-house.

The company emphasizes that its in-house knowledge of equipment, tooling, and skills allows it to translate customer ideas into producible designs efficiently, reducing waste. It also highlights its integrated approach, managing the product life cycle from concept through delivery, and its affiliate network for services like powder coating and media blasting.

about:
Somerset Foods, a family-owned wholesale food distributor, was founded in 1989 by brothers Bob, Randy, and Mike Spitz. Headquartered in Edison, New Jersey, the company serves customers across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, and Connecticut.

The company distributes a broad range of food products, beverages, and concession supplies, including frozen meats, canned goods, single-serve snacks, bulk cereals, fountain syrups, and specialty items such as gourmet popcorn kits and cotton candy supplies. Operations are supported by an online ordering platform and a delivery network that emphasizes speed and consistency.

Customers span child care centers requiring USDA-compliant meals, restaurants and taverns needing steady beverage and frozen stock, schools, concession stands at amusement parks, stadiums, and theaters, as well as youth sports leagues, fairs, festivals, food trucks, farm stands, and seasonal event vendors.

Somerset Foods highlights its decades-long relationships, dependable service, and a risk-free trial offering 10 percent off the first three orders as key differentiators. The business stresses fast, clear, and consistent order-to-delivery execution.

old_description: Somerset pizza dough rollers and bakery dough rollers provide solutions for a wide range of foodservice application. If dough production is part of your operation, our dough rollers are worthy of your consideration and set the industry standard for performance and reliability.
about:
Somerset Industries operates from Lowell, Massachusetts, where it designs and manufactures dough processing equipment for commercial foodservice operations. The company’s product line includes dough rollers, sheeters, rounders, presses, moulders, cheese shredders, meat shredders, and turnover machines.

The equipment is built with foodservice-grade stainless steel and features such as patented stick-resistant dough intake, maintenance-free drive mechanisms, and synthetic or metallic rollers. Models range from tabletop units like the CDR-500 sheeter to high-throughput rollers capable of 7,200 pieces per hour, and the SEP-760 press producing 300–500 pieces per hour. The SCS-150 cheese shredder processes over 25 pounds per minute and carries UL and NSF approvals.

Customers include pizzerias, bakeries, restaurants, schools, cafes, hospitals, government and military facilities, and ethnic food production operations. The company lists pizza, bakery, restaurant, school, hospital, and government/military as served industries.

Somerset emphasizes safety, durability, ease of use, and consistent performance, positioning its machines as tools that reduce labor costs and increase production output. The company also offers custom machine development, inviting customers to submit ideas for new equipment.

about:
Somerville Industries was founded in 1968 in Mineral Wells, West Virginia, and remains a family-owned business led by the Somerville family. The company serves as the parent organization for Somerville Fabricators and Somerville Manufacturing, operating from two locations that include a second facility in Devola, Ohio.

The company provides full-service manufacturing and fabrication in carbon steel and stainless steel, offering custom structural steel fabrication, detailing, and on-time delivery. With 45 employees across 55,000 square feet of combined fabrication space, Somerville Industries produces more than 4,000 tons of steel products annually.

Somerville Industries serves customers throughout the Mid-West and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States as well as Canada. Its fabrication work supports a range of industrial and construction projects, though specific industry sectors are not detailed in public materials.

The company's stated differentiator is its family-owned culture and the motto "Where Quality is our Character," emphasizing personal relationships with customers and staff from quoting through delivery.
